raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer incorrectly targeted Ensembl release 102 (November 2020) as applicable to the 20/10/2020 constraint, ignoring that the most recent release on that date was 101. This misinterpretation of the temporal requirement led the search down the wrong archive and culminated in providing an incorrect FTP directory (release-102) instead of the correct file link from release-101.
